explained.intro: Transaxillary breast augmentation has become increasingly popular in recent years since it enables you to have breast surgery performed without any scars left behind on the actual breasts.

safe.question: Is transaxillary breast augmentation safe?
safe.answer: Yes, transaxillary breast augmentation is very safe and carried out at multiple clinics throughout the country. It is growing in popularity all the time thanks to the fact that no scars are left on the breasts.

steps.title: Incisions at the armpits
steps.text: Transaxillary breast augmentation is performed by making incisions at the armpits, through which the implants are inserted.

steps.title: Guided by an endoscope
steps.text: The implants can be inserted with great precision through the use of an endoscope, a thin tube that has a camera and light on the end of it.

steps.title: Saline or silicone
steps.text: Both saline and silicone implants can be used, but the length of the scar will be affected by the type of implants. Saline implants are often used since they can be filled after being inserted and therefore a smaller incision can be made.

steps.title: Sutured, then heals naturally
steps.text: Once the implants are in place, the incision is then sutured and will heal naturally. Depending on the type of implants used, the patient will need to follow some aftercare advice, such as massaging the new implants to make sure they settle into place properly.

downside.title: Are there any downsides?
downside.text: Achieving perfect symmetry can be a little tougher compared to other methods but this usually isn’t an issue when the surgeon performing the procedure has a lot of experience with this particular method.

implants.title: Which Implant Is Right For You?
implants.subtitle: Work with our team to find the perfect shape and style for your body.

cards.title: Silicone
cards.text: Silicone implants provide a more natural feel but cost more, and you must be at least 22 years old to have them. An MRI once every three years is recommended to check for leakage.

cards.title: Saline
cards.text: Saline implants are cheaper, can be used for women 18 years old and above, and can be filled after they’re put in place. They’re made from a salt water solution.

cards.title: Ideal Implant
cards.text: IDEAL implants are a form of saline implant designed to reduce the problems commonly associated with regular saline implants, with a natural look and feel.

lifespan.heading: There is no definitive answer, since each result is uniquely dependent on the individual.

steps.title: No food for 8 hours
steps.text: Don’t eat anything for at least 8 hours prior to your surgery. This allows the anesthetic to take proper effect.

steps.title: Arrive 2 hours early
steps.text: You should arrive at the clinic 2 hours before your scheduled surgery time. Surgery is performed under general anesthesia in most facilities in the United States.

steps.title: Someone with you
steps.text: You are more prone to falling or fainting, so you need someone with you. Arrange for somebody to drive you home.

steps.title: Take at least a week off work
steps.text: If after a week you feel well enough, you can return to work, providing your job doesn’t require you to do anything that’s very physically demanding.

steps.title: No strenuous exercise
steps.text: Avoid strenuous exercise for at least the first couple of weeks. Running or jumping is not recommended for at least 6 weeks.
